metadata.title: [FIX][UI]: Disable public visibility radio button when ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY=false in edit forms
metadata.author: rakdutta

description:
closes issue https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/3318
This pull request refactors and standardizes how visibility restrictions are applied to entity edit forms in the admin interface. The main improvements include extracting a reusable function for applying visibility restrictions, updating element IDs for consistency, and ensuring that the correct radio buttons are disabled/styled in edit modals without altering the saved state.

**Refactoring and Code Reuse:**

* Introduced a new `applyVisibilityRestrictions` function in `admin.js` to handle disabling/styling of public visibility radio buttons across edit forms, improving code reuse and maintainability. (`mcpgateway/static/admin.js` [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-c14eef5270c1a251b36b2ef8aab846f5cf354a8fa43b10f0c367ca6f176d58ecL207-L233) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-c14eef5270c1a251b36b2ef8aab846f5cf354a8fa43b10f0c367ca6f176d58ecR245-R277)

**Consistency and Correctness in Edit Forms:**

* Updated all edit modal functions (`editTool`, `editA2AAgent`, `editResource`, `editPrompt`, `editGateway`, `editServer`) to call `applyVisibilityRestrictions` with the correct prefix, ensuring consistent application of visibility rules without changing the user's saved selection. (`mcpgateway/static/admin.js` [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-c14eef5270c1a251b36b2ef8aab846f5cf354a8fa43b10f0c367ca6f176d58ecR3723) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-c14eef5270c1a251b36b2ef8aab846f5cf354a8fa43b10f0c367ca6f176d58ecR4308) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-c14eef5270c1a251b36b2ef8aab846f5cf354a8fa43b10f0c367ca6f176d58ecR5093) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-c14eef5270c1a251b36b2ef8aab846f5cf354a8fa43b10f0c367ca6f176d58ecR5613) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-c14eef5270c1a251b36b2ef8aab846f5cf354a8fa43b10f0c367ca6f176d58ecR6187) [[6]](diffhunk://#diff-c14eef5270c1a251b36b2ef8aab846f5cf354a8fa43b10f0c367ca6f176d58ecR6957)

* Standardized visibility radio button IDs in the A2A Agent edit modal and updated corresponding JavaScript selectors to match, fixing previous inconsistencies and potential bugs. (`mcpgateway/static/admin.js` [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-c14eef5270c1a251b36b2ef8aab846f5cf354a8fa43b10f0c367ca6f176d58ecL4055-R4077) `mcpgateway/templates/admin.html` [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-b682d47c572db6413154e49d20e5c25175156da6fd767176bad1cc569b631b55L10917-R10948)

reviews.author: madhav165
reviews.body:
The patch introduces a behavior regression where edit modals can change an item's visibility unintentionally by reapplying create-form defaults after loading current values. This can alter access scope on save without explicit user intent.

Review comment:
- [P1] Avoid resetting saved visibility when opening edit modals — admin.js:3710-3710. Calling updateDefaultVisibility() after the edit form has been populated overwrites the entity’s existing visibility with the team/public default derived from URL scope. In team-scoped pages, editing an already public or private item now silently flips selection to team before submit, so saving without touching visibility can unintentionally change access level. The same pattern appears in all newly added edit-modal calls.

reviews.author: madhav165
reviews.body:
The patch introduces UI ID changes that are not propagated to existing Playwright tests, causing test regressions. Functionally the UI logic is improved, but the repository is left in a failing state without synchronized test updates.

Review comment:

- [P2] Keep A2A edit visibility IDs backward-compatible — admin.html:10922-10944. Renaming the A2A edit visibility radio IDs (a2a-visibility-*-edit → edit-a2a-visibility-*) breaks existing selectors in tests/playwright/entities/test_agents_extended.py, so the current Playwright flow for editing agent visibility will fail even though the UI still renders. If these IDs are changed, the corresponding test selectors need to be updated in the same patch to keep CI green.

reviews.author: madhav165
reviews.body:
PR tested for UI - Works as expected.

Previous feedback incorporated.

test: add differential coverage for applyVisibilityRestrictions styling

Cover missing code paths in applyVisibilityRestrictions:
- Verify opacity, cursor-not-allowed, line-through, and title when disabling
- Verify styling removal when public radio is no longer blocked
- Verify no-op when ALLOW_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY is true

fix: standardize visibility radio handling across all edit functions

Align editTool, editGateway, and editServer with the pattern used by
editA2AAgent, editResource, and editPrompt:
- Clear all radio buttons before setting the correct one
- Normalize visibility value with .toLowerCase() for case safety
